source_gap_claims.behavior: An alternate validator source must remain disallowed until an existing authorized owner coordinates it and independent Trust Approval binds matching source, content, complete dependencies, support policy, and scope before evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: Candidate-external trust verification does not entail the historical-root default or all conditions for changing it.
source_gap_claims.subject: Alternate validator source

source_gap_claims.behavior: Budget exhaustion must not reduce required coverage.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied budget obligation makes exhaustion unsuccessful, but does not preserve the coverage requirement after exhaustion.
source_gap_claims.subject: Bounded-execution coverage

source_gap_claims.behavior: Candidate must contain the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: Candidate execution and immutability do not establish that its contents include the intended change.
source_gap_claims.subject: Candidate Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: The complete Consumer Manifest must be non-empty, version-bound, and frozen before review.
source_gap_claims.reason: Bidirectional caller reconciliation and transitions for a non-empty manifest do not require this manifest state or freeze point.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer Manifest

source_gap_claims.behavior: Any Consumer or transition applicability exception must be approved and bound before execution.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations quantify over applicable Consumers, but do not prevent an implementation from declaring its own omission.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer applicability exceptions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Consumer must bind its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: Caller reconciliation and real route calls do not establish these per-Consumer evidence bindings.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer invocation evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: A success path must keep every required Consumer route check reachable.
source_gap_claims.reason: Manifest reconciliation and execution of applicable Consumers do not reject a success path that bypasses a required check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer route reachability

source_gap_claims.behavior: Enable and re-enable must each invoke the current approved Candidate Route; disable and rollback must each invoke the Prior Route and observe its baseline for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied transition obligation requires real calls and eventual baseline restoration, but does not assign these route and observation duties to each stage.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer route transitions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each named seed must bind its native evidence identity, and missing or drifted seed evidence must be rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: The seed obligations cover provenance and record fields, but do not require native evidence identity or rejection when that evidence is missing or changed.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each behavioral Atomic Obligation must have its own observable fault witness; every other obligation must have a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: Required-witness coverage does not establish the specified witness type or independence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact Cover witnesses

source_gap_claims.behavior: Before implementation authorization, process and aggregate budgets must use measured full-matrix, Consumer, and rollback timing.
source_gap_claims.reason: Bounded time and output obligations do not require the specified measurement basis before authorization.
source_gap_claims.subject: Execution-budget selection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Failed-candidate evidence must be preserved, with new evidence appended and isolated between route stages.
source_gap_claims.reason: Historical preservation and general evidence isolation do not require retention of failed-candidate evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Failed-candidate evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Replay must verify the exact original input identities before producing fresh process evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: Snapshot binding and fresh-checkout result equality do not impose this ordering and identity check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Fresh replay reconstruction

source_gap_claims.behavior: A current equivalent replay of the historical command must create new process evidence and state the boundary of equivalence.
source_gap_claims.reason: Preserving historical command identity and reproducing a current replay do not require an explicit equivalence boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical command replay

source_gap_claims.behavior: The six Matrix Cases must cover valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap with their stated behaviors.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require six materially distinct cases and distinct inputs, but do not bind the cases to these six semantic scenarios.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix Case semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Undeclared diagnostics or an expectation forged from copied output must invalidate the matrix aggregate.
source_gap_claims.reason: The aggregate rejection obligations cover copied or mislabeled evidence, but not these distinct diagnostic and expectation failures.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix aggregate validity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Matrix Case must have an expectation frozen before execution and separate observations for both subjects.
source_gap_claims.reason: Attributable evidence and distinct fixtures do not require a precommitted expectation or separate behavioral observations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix expectations and observations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Unaffected Matrix Cases must demonstrate preserved behavior, and an expected-difference result must not approve a regression.
source_gap_claims.reason: Two-sided execution and evidence validity do not establish the required non-regression comparison.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix non-regression verdict

source_gap_claims.behavior: A detached negative Probe must fail for its declared defect with the expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: Rejecting infrastructure failures and always-success results does not establish the required defect-specific outcome.
source_gap_claims.subject: Negative Probe oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: A detached positive Probe must pass validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require real process execution and bound inputs and outputs, but do not require a passing positive result.
source_gap_claims.subject: Positive Probe oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Probe must bind its actual target, command, and result to its execution evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: Probe input and output binding is covered, while these additional per-Probe bindings are not.
source_gap_claims.subject: Probe execution evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Defect-revealing tests must precede production behavior changes; existing passing behavior requires truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: Exact Cover and runtime evidence obligations do not impose this test ordering or reject fabricated RED evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Production-change verification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Writes to installed BMAD/GDS paths and Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and sandbox paths must be rejected within this repair scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: Historical immutability and artifact non-authority do not enforce these explicit write boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Protected implementation paths

source_gap_claims.behavior: Only the defined non-success terminal categories may represent their corresponding failures; serialized aliases must not merge failure into success or silently reinterpret a category.
source_gap_claims.reason: General fail-closed behavior and deterministic terminal states do not preserve this result taxonomy or alias meaning.
source_gap_claims.subject: Replay terminal semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Semantic Dependency closure must include every result-affecting executable, data artifact, policy, configuration value, and environment representation; Probe reachability must not narrow it.
source_gap_claims.reason: Independent verification of closure is covered, but the supplied obligations do not specify its required boundary or the reachability restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Semantic Dependency closure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Fresh-checkout Semantic Reproduction must also match diagnostic categories and required identity and evidence relationships.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied fresh-checkout obligations cover the terminal verdict and Exact Cover result, but omit these other defined components of Semantic Reproduction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Semantic Reproduction

source_gap_claims.behavior: A portable-field exclusion policy must be reviewed and versioned; it must not exclude a field affecting selection, observation, diagnostics, evidence validity, or authority, and policy changes must stale dependent results.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied drift rule does not define the conditions for exclusions or their effect on existing results.
source_gap_claims.subject: Snapshot normalization policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Stable must have verifiable provenance for existing source-supported behavior, bound before the run; a temporary comparison package alone must not qualify.
source_gap_claims.reason: Stable execution and immutability are covered, but eligibility and prior provenance binding are not.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable Package eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: The repair must reject a replacement TC-D1 requirement tree, Skill-input protocol redesign, TC-E0/D2–D6 implementation, seed promotion, and the listed autonomous or ranking features.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation enforces these explicit scope boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: TC-D1 scope boundaries
